name: scholar-rag-mcp
description: Academic paper knowledge-base MCP server: PDF ingest, vector search with reranking, KB management.
long_description: Point it at a folder of PDFs and it ingests each paper through a real parsing pipeline (MinerU), normalizes metadata, annotates section structure, chunks and embeds the text, and stores everything in Qdrant - after which an agent can semantically search chunks, run PubMed-style document queries, read full text section by section, add/remove single papers, and manage knowledge bases - all through 11 MCP tools over stdio. Requires OpenAI-compatible model endpoints (chat/embed/rerank, e.g. local vLLM) and local disk storage; see README.
